AMBULATORY ENCOUNTER & PROCEDURE NOTE
Patient: Dominic Rossi | DOB: 08/30/1982 | DOS: 02/05/2026
Treating Physician: Dr. Sarah Jenkins, MD (Physical Medicine & Rehabilitation, NPI: 1827364501)
Facility: Metro Spine & Pain Care Specialists

CHIEF COMPLAINT:
Follow-up evaluation for severe refractory lumbosacral radiculopathy and pre-procedure evaluation for scheduled trigger point injections.

EVALUATION & MANAGEMENT COMPONENT (Separate and Distinct - Modifier -25 justification):
Patient evaluated in exam room 4 prior to any injection. Thorough interval medical history taken regarding new onset radiating numbness into left lateral calf. Medication reconciliation performed (adjusting gabapentin from 300mg TID to 600mg TID due to breakthrough pain). Comprehensive discussion of MRI findings (L4-L5 disc protrusion) and risks/benefits of corticosteroid intervention. Independent medical decision making of moderate complexity (MDM Level 4) executed distinctly prior to the injection procedure.

PROCEDURE PERFORMED (CPT 20552):
Trigger point injections, 2 muscles (left lumbar iliocostalis and left piriformis). Performed under strict sterile technique with 1% lidocaine 4ml total. Patient tolerated well without complication.

BILLING & CODING JUSTIFICATION:
The Evaluation and Management service (CPT 99214-25) represents a significant, separately identifiable medical service above and beyond the usual pre-procedure and post-procedure work associated with CPT 20552. Both services occurred on the same date of service (02/05/2026) but warrant distinct unbundled reimbursement with appropriate Modifier -25 / -59 attachment.

Signed: Sarah Jenkins, MD, PM&R (02/05/2026 15:15 EST)
